scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
